notes: τοῖς λεγομένοις is split under rule 32 with rule 22's determiner clause: the things to the article headed on things, that were spoken to the participle.
ἐν τῷ ἀκούειν αὐτούς is analysed under rule 61 (when to ἐν, article unrepresented), with αὐτούς the expressed subject taking they on its own rather than as a helper on the infinitive.
